findings.location: task.errors[id=e1]: «Paseamos nuestro perro.»; feedbackUk: «Бракує con: «з кимось» — con + людина чи тварина.»
findings.description: «Pasear» also permits a transitive construction meaning to take an animal for a walk. Personal «a» with an animal common noun is not universally obligatory. The listed sentence therefore cannot simply be rejected as necessarily missing «con» under this unrestricted translation prompt.
findings.suggestion: Remove this reviewed error or explicitly require the learner to use «con». Explain that «pasear con nuestro perro» and transitive «pasear a nuestro perro» are different available constructions.

items.reviewerAnswer: Paseamos con nuestro perro. A transitive formulation meaning that we walk our dog is also possible.
items.notes: Prior teaching of «nuestro» is also unconfirmed: it is absent from this case's taughtBefore and explanatory hint; only the reveal supplies it. Confirm prior teaching or add a vocabulary gloss with targets [].

findings.suggestion: Confirm and map prior teaching of «nuestros», or add a vocabulary hint such as «nuestros amigos — наші друзі» with targets [].

findings.description: These endings also occur with «ustedes», meaning plural you. Presenting them simply as identifying «вони» gives a misleading rule and conflicts with the lesson's explicit teaching of ustedes agreement.
findings.suggestion: Explain that -an/-en mark third-person-plural verb forms used with ellos/ellas or ustedes; context identifies whether the meaning is they or plural you.
